sentence: Ḥedd ur yeẓṛi dakken qrib ad d-yas Tom.
credits: Sentence from Tatoeba by Igider (CC-BY 2.0 FR)
translations: No one doubts Tom will come soon.

usageExamples: Iɣil Tom belli Mary ur tebɣi ara ad tili i yiman-is.
Tom thinks that Mary won't be lonely.
